issues.description: The DDNode dataclass field ordering differs between the template and the solution. In the template implementation dd.py the DDNode is declared with fields (successors, v), whereas in the solution dd.py it is declared as (v, successors). Although both are valid Python dataclass declarations, this structural difference (field order and positional argument semantics) can confuse students who compare the solution with the template or attempt to construct DDNode objects positionally. It may also produce surprising behavior if students rely on positional construction instead of keyword arguments.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the DDNode dataclass field order consistent between template and solution (preferably (v, successors) as that matches the conceptual ordering 'v then successors' in the docstrings). Update any example usages or documentation to encourage constructing DDNode with keyword arguments (to avoid positional-argument pitfalls). If positional construction must be supported, ensure both repositories use the same field order.
